'''Myrkr Base''' was a [[Smugglers' Alliance]] base built by [[Talon Karrde]] in the [[Great Northern Forest]] on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Myrkr/Legends|Myrkr]].

==History==
In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], The Myrkr Base was the main base of operations of the [[Smugglers' Alliance]].

[[File:Karrdes_Myrkr_base.jpg|thumb|left|150px|[[Talon Karrde]]'s base map.]]

In the early phases of [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Thrawn campaign|campaign]], [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces moved on the world in order to secure supplies of [[Ysalamiri/Legends|ysalamiri]]. The smugglers stayed first neutral towards the Imperial forces but were eventually forced to [[Rescue on Myrkr|attack]] them after the capture of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] in the Great Northern Forest.

Consequently, Karrde's smugglers were forced to flee the Imperials and evacuate Myrkr to [[Rishi/Legends|Rishi]]. The base was emptied and abandoned. Thrawn returned to Myrkr after the [[Battle of Sluis Van]], using [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|AT-STs]] and [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|AT-ATs]] to invade the planet and secure the base. But as he had expected, Karrde had left no trace.
